newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Lyonnais no comment on London bond closure talk.
newsitem.headline: Cr Lyonnais no comment on London bond closure talk.

text.p: French state-owned bank Credit Lyonnais declined to comment on Thursday on market talk that it may be considering closing cash bond trading at its London-based operation Credit Lyonnais European securities.

Banking sources in London and Paris said on Thursday there was talk the bank planned to move German Bund trading back to Paris and to close its Scandinavian, Italian, U.S. Treasury and British government bond trading desks.
They said the talk was that Lyonnais would maintain its London-based presence in repurchase agreements and interest rate swaps.
Sources said about 11 sales and trading positions were involved.
